title: Le Chapeau: An Open-Source A/B Testing Platform for Conversational AI and LLM Interactions
description: Le Chapeau is a turnkey, open-source A/B testing platform engineered for conducting controlled experiments and randomized trials with conversational AI agents and Large Language Models (LLMs). The platform enables researchers to systematically assign participants to distinct conversational conditions (such as differing prompt strategies, persona scaffolding, or model variants) through pre-registered rosters or balanced dynamic allocation. It features real-time atomic interaction logging with zero data loss, GDPR/IRB-compliant salted deterministic pseudonymization (UUIDv5) for longitudinal participant tracking, and turnkey deployment via native scripts, Docker Compose, or multi-worker clusters.
